summary: Foto in Posa + Il Mio Book tested end-to-end. Backend: test_pose_book.py 7/7 pass (auth 401 on GET/POST/DELETE, CRUD + idempotent POST, foreign path 403, other user's DELETE 404, file 404 after delete, list isolation, quota unchanged). One REAL single try-on with preserve_pose:true (unsplash full-body street pose, hands on hood, wide stance + bomber jacket): done in 62s. The pose, face, background, light and framing were kept 100% and only the jacket was added. UI (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): the person-source toggle works (avatar is the default and unchanged), the pose panel and both big boxes work, webp is rejected with a toast, the jpg/png upload shows book-save-ask, No uses the photo without saving and Yes POSTs to /book and shows it in studio-book-grid and in the header modal. The modal X with confirm DELETEs it and both grids update. pose-camera with the Chromium fake stream: video, silhouette, shutter, close and the timer all work, the 5s countdown runs and the capture leads to book-save-ask. The intercepted payloads were preserve_pose:true for /tryon/generate and /outfit/generate-from-uploads, both with the pose path. Mobile header order: crown, ?, Book, Avatar, Logout. CopyLook gets avatarPath (code). One header layout bug was found (pre-existing, made worse by the new Book icon).

minor.issue: The only check is that the path prefix is the user's. It does not check that the file exists or is kind=person, so any own path (e.g. vfit/avatar/... or a tryon result) can be added. DELETE /book/{id} then marks that file is_deleted, so /api/files returns 404 for it (an API caller could break their own Avatar). Restrict to db.files kind=person, is_deleted false.

This only soft-flags db.files and does not delete the object from storage, while the brief says 'delete permanently'. Also, if the same photo is the person_path of past try-ons, those original images become 404.

ui_bugs.issue: The header row overflows horizontally. At 1920px: scrollWidth 1957, logout-btn right edge at 1957 (off-screen). At 1366px: scrollWidth 1490, book-btn at x=1358 (barely visible) and logout off-screen. At 390/360px: scrollWidth 392 (logout clipped 2px). Mostly pre-existing (owner crown + name/email block), but the new Book icon adds to it. Fix: tighten gaps, or hide name/email below ~1600px.

issues: In pose mode the subtitle still says 'Carica il capo: usiamo il tuo Avatar…'. Make it depend on the mode.
removeBook clears posePath even when DELETE fails (remove() swallows the error).
After 'No, solo ora' the photo is lost on reload. Expected, but there is no hint.

action_items: Fix header horizontal overflow at 1366/1920 (logout and Book icon off-screen) and the 2px overflow at 390px
POST /api/book: only accept db.files kind=person entries owned by the user (not avatar/tryon paths)
Optional: delete the storage object on Book delete if 'permanent' is required; make the Studio subtitle depend on the mode
critical_code_review_comments: POSE_RULE is appended only when preserve_pose is true, in both _render_single and _compose_outfit (extra param). Correct.
Grid endpoint checks _path_owner == user_id, while tryon uses _require_account_paths (family-aware). This is inconsistent for family profiles (pre-existing).
The 'No' answer still leaves the uploaded person file in storage/db.files (not in the Book). Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Temporary user test-book-other + session test_book_other_tok (deleted). All pose_book entries deleted. One real try-on record d0b4839a-ad9b-4f1a-b9de-98d33e44a5c2 is left in the owner's history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner cookie pending_test_tok. The Chromium fake camera works in browser_automation after context.grant_permissions(['camera']). Intercept /api/tryon/generate and /api/outfit/generate-from-uploads with page.route to check preserve_pose without paying for renders. Test images: /tmp/pose.jpg (unsplash photo-1515886657613-9f3515b0c78f) and /tmp/garment.jpg (photo-1591047139829-d91aecb6caea).
rca of the issue: Header overflow: the AppShell right-side flex row has no shrink/hide rules for owner extras. The crown, Book icon, avatar bubble, red initial, 2xl name/email block and logout together are wider than the space left after the nav links.
